01
Why a threshold fails
A single cut-off cannot separate 38 °C at 15 % humidity with 70 km/h wind from 42 °C in saturated still air. The first case is the dangerous one, and a temperature-only rule ranks it safe. Spread is non-linear in the same way: dry wind at moderate temperature ignites faster than a hot, humid afternoon.

02
Linguistic variables
Four inputs, four sets each — 16 in total. Trapezoids close the outer sets, so a reading past the sensor range saturates instead of running off the universe.
VarUniverseSets
T0–50 °Clow · moderate · high · extreme
RH0–100 %very low · low · moderate · high
WS0–100 km/hcalm · moderate · high · severe
FD0–100 %wet · moderate · dry · critical
Membership functions — temperature and fuel dryness shown; humidity and wind use the same four-set template. Outputs: fire risk index (4 sets), throttle urgency (3), suppression alert (4 sets on 0–3).
03
Rule base
4 inputs × 4 sets = 256 antecedent combinations, curated down to the 10 that are physically meaningful. any means the rule does not constrain that variable; min for AND, max for aggregation. Every rule fires all three consequents at once.
RuleTRHWSFDRiskThr.Alert
R1anyHighanyWetLowStandardAdvisory
R2LowModerateanyanyLowStandardAdvisory
R3ModerateanyanyModerateModerateStandardWatch
R4ModerateanyHighDryHighAcceleratedWarning
R5HighLowanyanyHighAcceleratedWarning
R6HighanySevereanyExtremeEmergencyEvacuate
R7ExtremeVery LowanyanyExtremeEmergencyEvacuate
R8anyanyHighCriticalExtremeEmergencyEvacuate
R9ExtremeanyanyCriticalExtremeEmergencyEvacuate
R10anyHighCalmanyLowStandardAdvisory
Firing strength α = min(µ of each antecedent); aggregated output µagg(y) = max over rules. The alert consequent is a separate fuzzy inference on [0, 3], so it is not a threshold applied to the risk index.
04
Defuzzification
y* = ∫ y · µagg(y) dy / ∫ µagg(y) dy
Fire risk index under each method, four scenarios. The three methods do not separate on speed; they separate on continuity. Last column is the centroid-to-MOM gap.
ScenarioCOGBisectorMOMGap
Benign Clear Day17.517.517.50.0
Dry Spring Heat55.655.656.20.6
High Hazard Drought70.370.370.60.3
Critical Wildfire92.292.595.12.9
MOM returns the mean of the aggregated set's maxima, so crossing a boundary jumps the output between peaks — a torque step on a 250 g airframe. Centroid integrates the whole area, so its output is continuous in the input.

The alert track does not simply mirror the risk track: waypoint 04 reads FRI 84.3 against 79.0 % throttle but only alert 2.49, because fuel dryness falls to 85.8 % while wind stays at 45.3 km/h. A single threshold on the risk index cannot express that.
07
Conclusion
Four inputs, ten auditable rules and a closed loop inside Isaac Sim; 25 unit tests pass. Limitation: simulation only, rule base expert-tuned, edge latency projected rather than measured. Next: ANFIS tuning, multi-UAV mesh, PX4 and Matrice 300 field trials.
Impact. Early thermal detection within the first 15–30 minutes of ignition catches fire before crown spread (SDG 13.1) and protects forest habitat (SDG 15.2); exact coordinates cut containment time, water use and crew exposure.
